# Third-party notices

## Trigger.dev

Skyline's shell, Runs interface, trace viewer, inspector, timeline, and styles are derived from [Trigger.dev](https://github.com/triggerdotdev/trigger.dev) commit `ca9a74e84abdf9483c234e82dc54b9ec2c00d8c0`, licensed under Apache-2.0. The complete source map, upstream hashes, destinations, and modifications are recorded in `resources/js/trigger/import-manifest.json`. The license is reproduced at `licenses/trigger.dev-APACHE-2.0.txt`.

Skyline replaces Trigger.dev routing, server loaders, data types, authentication, persistence, product branding, and unsupported product actions. It retains only the applicable client shell, Runs, trace, timeline, inspector, panel, filter, pagination, polling, and keyboard interactions. Trigger.dev trademarks, logos, and wordmarks are not distributed.
